title: Hallmark Peanuts WOODSTOCK 8" Halloween Bat Bean Bag Plush Yellow/Purple Wings
descriptionText: The product is an 8" Halloween-themed bat-shaped plush stuffed animal featuring the beloved character Woodstock from the Peanuts franchise. With its yellow color and plush material, this collectible item is perfect for fans of cartoon and TV characters. The cute design and bird-like animal species make it a charming addition to any collection or as a fun gift for Peanuts enthusiasts.
